Congrats, you've successfully landed on the $(thing)Moon$()! Here, you'll find $(item)Certus Quartz$() veins and the meteors that allow you to begin unlocking $(thing)AE2$().$(br2)But that's not all — some veins here have much higher density than those on Earth. For instance, you can easily find $(item)Ilmenite$(), $(item)Bauxite$(), $(item)Aluminium$(), and $(item)Chromite$() veins on the Moon.

Establishing a small base here will be crucial to keep progressing.$(br2)Your biggest challenge will be transporting resources, as there are no easy cross-dimensional tools like the $(item)Ender Chest$() or $(thing)AE2 Quantum Link$() just yet.$(br2)We hope you're well prepared, unless you want to craft a second rocket and space suit just to go collect your corpse!

pages.title: Flag Planter
pages.text: Introduce yourself to the Moon by planting a flag with whatever image you like on it!

pages.title: Breathable Gases
pages.text: Find yourself a little short of breath? You'll need something to breathe up in space, so you'll want to look at producing any of these compressed gases, based off real-world ones used for deep sea diving!

You can fill your space suit with them the same way you'd fill up a bucket, or if you bring along a $(item)Gas Tank$() you'll be able to "drink" from it to replenish your suit without taking it off.$(br2)$(thing)Nitrox$() is probably the easiest to produce on Earth, while you can set up $(thing)Heliox-3$() on the Moon.$(br2)A full space suit (2500mB) will last about $(item)45 minutes$().

pages.title: Helium-3
pages.text: The Moon is full of $(thing)Helium-3$(), another important resource, but it's stuck inside the stone! There's two ways to get your hands on some:$(li)$(l:the_moon/the_moon#asurine)Asurine Centrifuging$()$(li)$(l:the_moon/the_moon#fluid_rig)Fluid Drilling Rig$()

$(thing)Helium-3$() is used for several things, of which the most important is making more air to breathe via $(l:the_moon/the_moon#gases)Heliox-3$()! You can also use it as "fertilizer" for $(l:the_moon/moon_crops)Chorus Fruit$() in the $(l:agriculture/greenhouse)Electric Greenhouse$(), and eventually as another fuel for Fusion Power.$(br2)You will eventually want to set up an automatic process for $(item)Trimix-3$() to fully power a $(l:the_moon/the_moon#lsa)Large Solar Array$(), by combining $(thing)Helium-3$(), $(6)$(t:Easiest to obtain via cobblestone into flint into silicon dioxide)Oxygen$(), and $(l:the_moon/moon_crops#nitrogen)Nitrogen$().

If you haven't set up any stone-related automation before, here's a quick introduction: A Rock Crusher can produce infinite raw stone, which a Macerator crushes into dust for a Centrifuge to process. Here on the Moon, $(item)Asurine$() can thus be processed into an infinite source of $(thing)Helium-3$()!

pages.title: Fluid Drilling Rig
pages.text: Using a $(item)Fluid Drilling Rig$() is simpler, but doesn't come with any useful byproducts.$(br2)Regular $(thing)Helium$() and $(thing)Argon$() fluid deposits are also available on the moon.

pages.title: Rover
pages.text: The $(item)Rover$() is a vehicle that can hold up to two passengers, runs on combustible fuels (Diesels, Gasolines, and Rocket Fuel), and even has an inventory and radio that can play real-world radio stations!

pages.title: Solar Panels
pages.text: There are very few energy sources available on the Moon, but these $(item)Solar Panels$() have a lovely view of the Sun from up here!$(br)On the moon, each Solar Panel provides the equivalent of $(thing)32 EU/t$() during the day with no fuel or upkeep needed. You will need to use an $(item)FE to EU converter$(), as there are no FE cables.

pages.title: Large Solar Array
pages.text: Small solar panels not cutting it? The $(thing)Large Solar Array$() is your primary solution for power generation on the moon, as other Earth-based power generation methods do not work up here.$(br2)The $(item)LSA$() comes in three tiers, so you can upgrade it as you progress.
Use a $(item)Terminal$() to construct the multiblock easily.

pages.text: So far you may be surviving, but do you want to truly $(italic)thrive$()? If you're wanting to set up a more permanent base, look no further than the $(item)Oxygen Distributor$()! Feed it one of the compressed gases from earlier and it will "oxygenate" a large enclosed area.

Any $(item)solid block$() will work to build your base out of, but you'll want a proper airlock to ensure the gas doesn't all escape in a $(thing)vortex$(). When combined with a $(item)Heat Pump$(), the enclosed space will become inhabitable, letting you take your helmet off, grow crops and place a water source without it freezing.$(br2)Energy consumption scales off of room size so make sure to give the appropriate energy hatch to your distributor.
The $(item)Vent$() is a solid block that can also let breathable air through without causing a vortex.

pages.title: Sliding Doors
pages.text: You will want to set up a proper $(thing)airlock system$() between your base's insides and the vacuum of space. Other normal doors will work, but these 3x3 doors are very thematically appropriate for a high-tech moon base. They can be automated with a $(item)pressure plate$() as usual.$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() You can also use these doors for cleanrooms!

The $(item)Higgs Emitter$() allows you to create artificial gravity, filling a sealed area like with a $(item)Heat Pump$() or $(l:the_moon/the_moon#distributor)Oxygen Distributor$(). The area size scales off of the multiblock's energy hatch tier.
$(item)Space Paintings$() can provide some cool space-themed decoration in your base, or if you're homesick and just really want a big painting of Earth.

pages.title: Extraterrestrial Death
pages.text: In $(tfg_short), you can set your spawn on any dimension with a bed (even $(l:beneath/beneath)The Beneath$()!), but unless you've got a bunch of extra space suits lying around, respawning on the Moon might complicate things.

First of all, you'll definitely want your bed to be inside an $(l:the_moon/the_moon#distributor)oxygenated area$(), so you don't immediately die as soon as you respawn.$(br2)In case of a blackout, you should have enough time to break your bed and reset your spawn back to Earth.

Secondly, you can upgrade each piece of your $(thing)Space Suit$() with a $(item)Soul Pearl$(). This will make them stay equipped when you die!$(br2)You can get these from any of the tougher, hostile $(l:the_moon/moon_fauna#endermen)Endermen$() on the Moon.$(br2)$(italic)We promise it's sci-fi and not magic.$()
